add_product: Add a new product or service to your store.
view_orders: View and manage your recent orders.
messages: Read and respond to customer messages.
stats: See how many people are visiting your store and buying things.
share: Share your store link with customers.
ask_ai: Ask your helper to do things for you.
advisory_hint: Get smart tips on how to improve your sales.
quick_actions_hint: These buttons are shortcuts to your most common daily tasks.
api_docs_advanced: Show technical details for developers. If you are not a developer, you can ignore this.
api_test_button: Send a test request to see how the software responds. This is for testing custom code.
ai_chat_send: Send your message to the AI Helper.
api_docs: Connect other software to your store.
grow_business: Find ways to get more customers.
referrals: Reward customers for sharing your store.
social_posting: Post updates to your social media.
kairos_orchestration: Let AI run complex tasks in the background. This saves you time on daily operations.
video_tutorials: Watch short videos to learn how to use the app. They are all under 90 seconds.
release_notes: See what new features we just added to the app.
offering_hint: Choose Physical for items you ship, Digital for files like PDFs, or Service for bookings and your time.
details_hint: Fill in these details to help your customers understand exactly what they are getting.
